decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - None of the units hereby approved shall be subdivided and the residential part of any unit shall only be used and occupied by the occupiers of the attached business floorspace of the same unit or a person solely or mainly employed at that unit.
	
To safeguard the employment opportunities of the site, in accordance with Policies E1 and E2 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 2 - Development in connection with the erection of the 2 live/work units at the rear of the site shall not commence prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Council of full details (including floor plans to a scale of 1:50) of the arrangement of the B1 floorspace within the units, which must comprise a minimum of 25% of the total floorspace in each case, and no part of either unit shall be used or occupied prior to the completion of the development in full compliance with the approved details
	
In order to ensure that the development will safeguard the employment opportunities of the site and to optimise the potential of the Class B1 floorspace, in accordance with Policies E1 and E2 of the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2005/02728/DET dated 12.07.2006.

Condition : 3 - The building on the frontage shall be used for purposes specified within the permission (Class E). Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any orders revoking and re-enacting those orders with or without modification) and any annotations on the approved plans, the premises shall not be used for any uses falling within Use Class E(a) (retail), E(b) (food and drink), E(d) (Indoor Sport) or E(f) (creche, day nursery or day centre).

To safeguard the employment opportunities of the site and to ensure that there would be no adverse impact upon residential amenity by reason of noise and disturbance, odour, or traffic generation, in accordance with Policies E2, HO11, CC11, CC13 and T1 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The development shall not commence prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Council of details and samples (where appropriate) of the materials to be used in the construction of the external faces of the building, roadways, footways and other hard surfaces, and no part of the development shall be used or occupied until the development has been completed in full accordance with the approved details.
	
To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2007/01758/DET dated 25.10.2007.

Condition : 5 - Any changes to the external appearance of the building including the installation of air conditioning units, ventilation fans or extraction equipment not shown on the approved drawings, must first be submitted and approved in writing by the Council prior to their installation.
	
To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to protect the menities of neighbouring residential occupiers, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, HO11, CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The development shall not commence prior to the submission and approval in writing by the council of details of a scheme for the removal of the existing crossovers and reinstatement of the footway and no part of the development shall be used or occupied until the works have been carried out and completed in accordance with the approved details.
	
In the interests of public safety and to avoid vehicle/ pedestrian conflict, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2007/01759/DET dated 25.10.2007.

Condition : 7 - The development shall not commence prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Council of details of the proposed scheme for the protection of the proposed access road, by means of a bollard or bollards, and no part of the development shall be used or occupied prior to the completion of the works in full compliance with the approved details.
	
In the interests of public safety and to avoid vehicle/ pedestrian conflict, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2008/01808/DET dated 23.09.2008.

Condition : 8 - No part of the development shall be used or occupied prior to the provision and completion of the proposed access road, service road, turning arrangements and the 8 parking spaces indicated on approved drawing 0102/01A, and the said access, service, turning and parking arrangements shall thereafter not be used other than to provide access, servicing, turning and parking facilities respectively.
	
In the interests of public safety and to avoid vehicle/ pedestrian conflict, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 9 - The development shall not commence prior to the completion of a desktop study, an intrusive investigation and risk assessment and the details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the council. The risk assessment shall  assess the degree and nature of any contamination on site and the risks posed by any contamination to human health, controlled waters and the wider environment. The scope of the investigation shall be agreed with the Council prior to its commencement. A detailed method statement for any required remediation works shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council.
	
To ensure that no unacceptable risks are caused to humans, controlled waters or the wider environment during and following the development works, in accordance with Policy CC9 the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2008/02023/DET dated 27.08.2008 and 2011/00919/DET dated 11.05.2011.

Condition : 10 - The development shall not commence until any required remediation works have been completed and a validation report to verify these works has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Council.
	
To ensure that no unacceptable risks are caused to humans, controlled waters or the wider environment during and following the development works, in accordance with Policy CC9 the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2008/02023/DET dated 27.08.2008 and 2011/00919/DET dated 11.05.2011.

Condition : 11 - The development shall not commence prior to the submission and approval in writing by the council of details of a landscaping scheme for the open areas of the site.
	
To ensure a satisfactory provision for planting, in accordance with Policy OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2007/01760/DET dated 25.10.2007.

Condition : 12 - All planting, seeding and turfing approved as part of the submitted landscaping scheme shall be carried out in the first planting or seeding seasons following the occupation of the buildings or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner; and any trees which die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased within 5 years of the date of the initial planting shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size and species.
	
To ensure a satisfactory provision for planting, in accordance with Policy OS5 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 13 - The existing boundary wall between the application site and 25 and 27 Broomhouse Road shall be retained, as indicated on the submitted drawings, and shall not be demolished or reduced in height.
	
In order to safeguard the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring properties in terms of loss of outlook and sense of enclosure, in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 14 - Noise from machinery or equipment operated in connection with the development shall not increase the hourly background sound level which exists in the absence of such machinery or equipment operating. The background sound level shall be measured, for the purposes of this condition, on the boundary of the site at a position nearest the noise source, or at the nearest window to a habitable room in separate occupation from the operator of the noise source, whichever is the closer.
	
In order that the machinery and equipment used in connection with the permitted use does not give rise to conditions that would be detrimental to the amenities of surrounding occupiers by reason of noise disturbance, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018.

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2011/02074/DET dated 25.08.2011.

Condition : 15 - The flat roofs at second and third floor level provided by the live/work buiding to be built on the rear part of the site, as indicated on drawing 0102/04B, shall not be converted into or used as terraces or other amenity space.
	
Such a use would be likely to harm the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking and loss of privacy and the potential generation of additional noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 16 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence until details of cycle parking facilities have been submitted and approved in writing by the Council, and the parking facilities as approved have been fully installed.

To ensure that the proposal is in accordance with Policy T3 of the Local Plan (2018).

Details for this condition have been approved under ref. 2003/02961/DET dated 23.12.2003.

Condition : 17 - Prior to first operation of any alternative use of the premises, an Operational Management Plan (OMP) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include details of hours of operation and delivery/servicing arrangements.

The uses hereby approved shall then be operated in full accordance with the approved OMP.

To ensure that there would be no adverse impact upon the operation of the public highway and to prevent noise and disturbance to neighbouring residents, in accordance with Policies HO11, CC11, CC13 and T1 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 18 - Noise from uses and activities within the building/ development site shall not exceed the criteria of BS8233:2014 at neighbouring noise sensitive/ habitable rooms and private external amenity spaces.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Variation of Condition 4 to provide minor material amendments to planning permission reference: 2003/02174/FUL dated 31st October 2003 for the "Erection of a three storey, plus part basement building (1040 sq m) to be used as offices (Class B1) on the Peterborough Road frontage, and a pair of 2 storey plus basement semi-detached properties on the rear of the site, comprising 2 live work units; together with related car parking and servicing. (Revision to planning permission 2001/2651/P) dated 10th July 2002 - revisions relate to change of use of the building on the frontage from live work to wholly office (Class B1)."  Amendment sought is to allow the building on the frontage to be used for purposes within wider Class E of the Use Classes Order, except for E(a), E(b), E(d) and E(f), in order to increase the flexibility of letting within Class E, whilst retaining commercial/employment use.
